title: Oscillatory replacement

mathematical_result.statement: For original coordinate blocks P={p1,p2}, Z={z1,z2}, disjoint bank J, if A[Z,J]=0, A[Z,Z]=diag(a,c) with ac!=0, and K=A[P,J] has rank two with Delta=sigma1(K)sigma2(K), then retaining arbitrary P-P, P-Z, J-J, outside couplings and affine terms, the full form has a C0 density with ||p_Q||inf <= (9/2) Delta^(-1/3)|ac|^(-1/6).
mathematical_result.scalar_input: For every cap-one original-coordinate law and a!=0, integral |E exp(it(aX^2+ell X+c0))|^4 dt <= 27pi/(2|a|).

correction.statement: For q(x,y)=xy and cap-one joint density 1_{1<=x<=R,0<=y<=(log R)^(-1)/x}, the output density equals log R on an interval of length 1/log R, so its L2-square is log R. Hence no determinant-only arbitrary-joint planar L2 oscillatory estimate can hold for indefinite H. This is not a QFORM counterexample because the source is dependent.

premises.application: On the Hadamard two-hub subfamily with dense leaf phase removed, G~=sigma^2 I_2 and leaf leverage 2/N, giving |phi(t)|<=4pi^2 sigma^-2 |t|^-2 and ||p_Q||inf<=4/sigma; D/D'/D5 vanish on the natural rank-two packet.
Definite sibling with Delta=epsilon^-1 and d2=epsilon^2 gives ||p_Q||inf <=3(pi/2)^(1/3)<3.488.

premises.scope: rank-at-least-three cross packets; explicitly leaves rank-two cross plus tiny third singular direction unpaid

stress_family.parameters: sigma=epsilon^-1/2, diffuse rank-two Hadamard hub-leaf cross block, original coordinate kernel diag(epsilon,-epsilon), dense full-rank leaf self-curvature epsilon H_N/N
stress_family.strict_n3: for fixed tau in (0,1], choose epsilon<min(1/4,tau), then N>1/(epsilon tau) sufficiently large
stress_family.spectral_check: at least four eigenvalues retain modulus greater than one by Weyl from the epsilon/sqrt(N) dense leaf term

next_step: Route every remaining mixed indefinite/nearly-singular rank-two cross-kernel state either to an original/grouped-product two-dimensional kernel, the partner definite-kernel theorem, or an already-paid volume/hub/ridge/pair/grouped-square/exact-null receiver without rotating away product independence.
